content.title: Oscars 2026 Recap: 'One Battle After Another' Wins Best Picture; Highlights Recap
content.text: 11d ago / 11:05 PM EDTConan O'Brien Sends a Subtle Message to Martin ShortAs the Oscars were closing, host Conan O'Brien ended his duties by sending a message to his friend, Martin Short. “We love you Marty Short,” the comedian shouted before the final skit aired and the credits rolled. The nod comes after Short's daughter, Katherine Short, died last month at the age of 42. A rep for the Short family confirmed her death in a statement shared with TODAY.com on Tuesday, Feb. 24.“It is with profound grief that we confirm the passing of Katherine Hartley Short. The Short family is devastated by this loss, and asks for privacy at this time,” the statement read. “Katherine was beloved by all and will be remembered for the light and joy she brought into the world.”11d ago / 11:03 PM EDTThe Final Oscars Tallies Are...The following films won multiple Oscars during the 2026 Oscars ceremony."One Battle After Another": 6"Sinners": 4"Frankenstein": 3"KPop Demon Hunters": 211d ago / 10:46 PM EDTLeonardo DiCaprio and Benicio del Toro in "One Battle After Another" YouTubeThe final award of the night has been handed to Paul Thomas Anderson for his film "One Battle After Another," the best picture winner. Entering the night, "One Battle After Another" had 13 nominations. It ended the ceremony with six wins and Anderson on stage celebrating with stars Teyana Taylor, Chase Infiniti, Leonardo DiCaprio and Regina Hall. Producer Sara Murphy gave the acceptance speech. "Getting to make this film with this cast and this crew, and Paul, has already been the greatest filmmaking experience I can fathom," she said. "So receiving this award is just beyond. My heart is exploding with gratitude."She thanked her producing partners, family and Warner Bros. before Anderson took over. He listed the best picture nominees in 1975, which included "One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest" and "Jaws." "There is no best among them. There is just what that mood might be that day. But we're happy to be a part of this," he said. He added that he "blew it" when he won his best directing award and didn't thank his cast. So, he made up for it by saying all their names. "What a night. You guys, let's have a martini. This is pretty amazing. Cheers!" he concluded. 11d ago / 10:45 PM EDTOscars End with Conan O'Brien Spoofing Sean Penn's Fate in 'One Battle After Another'Spoilers ahead for the newly minted best picture nominee "One Battle After Another." The 2026 Oscars ended with another skit from host Conan O'Brien. This time, he spoofed the fate of Sean Penn's character in "One Battle After Another." After Penn's character, Lockjaw, went to great lengths to secure his place in the white supremacist organization, the Christmas Adventurers Club, his "reward" of a new office turns out to be a death sentence. Similarly, in the final skit, O'Brien is told he'll be the Oscars "host for life," receiving a corner office in the process. But after propping his feet up on his new desk, green gas fills the room, and he's seen being wheeled out and put into a furnace. The "host for life" name on the door is replaced with "Mr. Beast," referring to the YouTuber with nearly 30 million subscribers.11d ago / 10:39 PM EDTJessie Buckley Wins Best Actress for 'Hamnet'Jessie Buckley accepts the actress in a leading role award for "Hamnet." Kevin Winter / Getty ImagesJessie Buckley won her first Oscar for best actress in a leading role for her performance in the drama "Hamnet." The movie is a fictional account of William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes Hathaway, who are forced to cope with the loss of their 11-year-old son Hamnet.Buckley was the frontrunner for the Oscar after already winning in her category at this year's Critics Choice, Golden Globes, BAFTA and Actor Awards. The Irish actor and singer, 36, who welcomed her first child, a daughter, last year with husand Freddie Sorensen, told her fellow nominees — Rose Byrne, Kate Hudson, Renate Reinsve, Emma Stone — she wanted "to work with every single one of you." Buckley also thanked her parents for "teaching us to dream" and joked to Sorenson that she wanted to have "20,000 more babies" with him.11d ago / 10:36 PM EDTIt's a 'Moulin Rouge' Reunion!Ewan McGregor and Nicole Kidman took the Oscars stage to celebrate 25 years since the film premiered in 2001.Speaking about the value of "love," the two took a moment to croon some of their most memorable lyrics from "Elephant Love Medley." Ewan McGregor and Nicole Kidman have a "Moulin Rouge" reunion during the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter / Getty Images11d ago / 10:30 PM EDTAdrien Brody Pokes Fun at His Long Acceptance Speech From Last Year's OscarsAdrien Brody onstage during the 98th Oscars at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood. Kevin Winter / Getty ImagesLast year leading actor Oscar winner Adrien Brody poked fun at himself when presenting the best actor category. First Conan O'Brien joked about Brody's extra long 2025 acceptance speech, saying, “Our next presenter heroically saved last year’s Oscars from running short. Please welcome Oscar winner Adrien Brody.”The actor then walked on stage and took out pages and pages of notes as music started playing. He then cracked that he did have something very important to say, which was to present the nominees for best actor in a leading role.11d ago / 10:30 PM EDTMichael B. Jordan Wins Best Actor for 'Sinners'The audience leapt to their feet and loudly applauded as Michael B. Jordan won the best actor Oscar for his flawless portrayal of twins Smoke and Stack in "Sinners." After last year's recipient Adrien Brody poked fun at his lengthy speech, he presented the Oscar to Jordan, who appeared stunned when his name was read. Michael B. Jordan accepts the actor in a leading role award for "Sinners" during the 98th Oscars at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood. Kevin Winter/Getty ImagesHe celebrated with his co-stars and mom before taking the stage as the thunderous applause continued. "Man, God is good," he began. "Mama, what's up? Y'all know how I feel about my mother."He added that his father was also in attendance and flew in from Ghana to go to the ceremony. His brother and sister and other members of his family were there, too.Jordan spoke about the importance of "betting on a culture and betting on original ideas and original artistry." He said he was "honored" to call director Ryan Coogler a collaborator and a friend."You gave me the opportunity and a space for me to be seen. I love you to death," he told Coogler before thanking the cast.He recognized the Black actors who have accepted Oscars before him, including Sidney Poitier, Denzel Washington, Halle Berry, Jamie Foxx, Forest Whitaker and Will Smith."I know you guys want me to do well and I want to do that because you guys bet on me," he said about his supporters. "And I'm going to keep stepping up. I'm going to keep being the best version of myself I can be." 11d ago / 10:22 PM EDT'KPop Demon Hunters' Wins for Original Song “KPop Demon Hunters” continued to win at the Oscars when the movie’s global hit anthem “Golden” won in the best original song category. The song is co-written by K-pop songwriter/producer EJAE and composer Mark Sonnenblick and performed by the movie's fictional group HUNTR/X. It is the first K-pop song to win an Oscar.“KPop Demon Hunters” also won an Oscar for best animated feature earlier in the ceremony.The award was presented by music legend Lionel Richie, who noted he won an Oscar for best original song 40 years ago for the ballad "Say You, Say Me" from the motion picture "White Nights."Other songs nominated in the best original song category included “Dear Me” from “Diane Warren: Relentless," “Highest 2 Lowest” from “Highest 2 Lowes," “I Lied To You” from “Sinners," "Sweet Dreams of Joy” from “Viva Verdi!” and “Train Dreams” from “Train Dreams.”11d ago / 10:22 PM EDTPaul Thomas Anderson Wins Oscar for Best Director: 'You Make A Guy Work Hard for One of These 'Paul Thomas Anderson won the Oscar for best directing for "One Battle After Another," his first time winning the award after directing films like "Boogie Nights" and "There Will Be Blood." “You make a guy work hard for one of these," he quipped in his speech.He also shouted out his "classmates" and fellow nominees, including Chloé Zhao and Ryan Coogler.While Anderson said he'll always doubt that he deserves the award, "there is no question at the pleasure of having it for myself." In the audience, partner Maya Rudolph as well as "One Battle After Another" stars Teyana Taylor, Chase Infiniti and Leonardo DiCaprio cheered exuberantly.11d ago / 10:10 PM EDT'Sentimental Value' Wins Best International Feature FilmThe cast of "Sentimental Value" all joined director Joachim Trier on stage as he accepted the Oscar for best international feature film. After presenters Priyanka Chopra and Javier Bardem announced the list of nominees and revealed the Norwegian film as the winner, Trier reflected on his career. "I'm just a film nerd from Norway," he said. "Thank you so much, honestly. This means the world to me.""This film is about a very dysfunctional family and it's the opposite of what I felt with this beautiful group behind me. I think I make films to feel at home with people. I really felt at home with (the) crew. There's 1,072 people in these credits and I love them all and I share this with them," he added. He also took a moment recognize his fellow nominees: “The Secret Agent,” “It Was Just an Accident,” “Sirat” and “The Voice of Hind Rajab.”11d ago / 10:01 PM EDT'Sinners' Wins Oscar for Cinematography, Marking 1st Woman to Receive the Award"Sinners" cinematographer Autumn Durald Arkapaw took home the Oscar for best cinematography. She thanked director Ryan Coogler for trusting her vision for the film.Arkapaw, who per the LA Times and Variety is the first woman to win this Oscar, also asked all the women in the room to stand up to be applauded, explaining that their contributions helped her to succeed."Moments like this happen because of you guys," she said.The category was rounded out by “Frankenstein," “Marty Supreme," “One Battle After Another" and "Train Dreams.”11d ago / 9:59 PM EDTHUNTR/X From 'KPop Demon Hunters' Deliver 'Golden' Performance at OscarsThey're goin’ up, up, up, it was HUNTR/X's moment at the 2026 Oscars. Ejae, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami, better known as the singing voices behind the "KPop Demon Hunters” girl group, performed their hit and Oscar-nominated song “Golden.”"KPop Demon Hunters" was celebrated during the Oscars with a performance of "Golden." PATRICK T. FALLON / AFP via Getty ImagesThe performance was a celebration of the film, which won the best animated film Oscar earlier in the telecast, and included a fusion of traditional Korean instrumentalists and dance. Before the performance, the Academy noted that it would also honor “the folklore and cultural inspiration that anchors the story behind this animated blockbuster.”Rei Ami, EJAE, and Audrey Nuna perform onstage during the 98th Oscars on March 15, 2026. Kevin Winter / Getty ImagesDancers filled the stage as voiceover from the film was heard and the animated film was shown in the back. HUNTR/X, dressed in all white, then kicked off their spectacular performance that got the crowd excited. The singers showcased their incredible vocals as the audience held yellow light sticks. "KPop Demon Hunters" premiered June 20, 2025, and follows dueling K-pop groups with secret supernatural origins. Months after its release, six songs from the movie’s soundtrack took over Billboard’s Hot 100 chart, with two rising into the top 10 slots, according to Billboard’s website.11d ago / 9:57 PM EDTThe Best Picture Race Remains Tight"One Battle After Another" and "Sinners" entered tonight's Oscars dominating the nominations, and with several categories still to go, there's seemingly no clear favorite.The two heavyweight films are taking turns receiving big wins. "One Battle After Another" currently has four wins: best casting, best supporting actor, best adapted screenplay and best film editing."Sinners," meanwhile, has three: best original screenplay, best original score and best cinematography. 11d ago / 9:52 PM EDT'One Battle After Another' Wins Oscar for Best Editing, Presented by Bill and Lewis PullmanFather-son duo Bill and Lewis Pullman teamed up to present the Oscar for best film editing, where they worked in a few comments about the experience of working in the same industry as your relative.The Oscar went to Andy Jurgensen for "One Battle After Another."11d ago / 9:42 PM EDT'F1' Wins Best Sound Add "F1" to the list of winners this evening as the blockbuster picked up an Oscar for best sound. To collect the golden statue, sound engineers Gareth John, Al Nelson, Gwendolyn Yates Whittle, Gary A. Rizzo and Juan Peralta took the stage. Peralta thanked everyone who worked on the film for "supporting such a fun cinematic experience."John and Whittle also expressed gratitude for their entire sound team and their families. Whittle ended her remarks by encouraging film lovers to go watch and support movies. 11d ago / 9:39 PM EDT'Sinners' Wins Award for Original Score"Sinners" composer Ludwig Göransson won the Oscar for best original score, which was presented with no shortage of quips by the reunited stars of "Bridesmaids."It was a third Oscar win for the Swedish musician, who previously won in 2019 for "Black Panther" and in 2024 for "Oppenheimer." Other movies nominated for original score included “Bugonia," “Frankenstein," “Hamnet” and “One Battle After Another.”11d ago / 9:38 PM EDT'Bridesmaids' Stars Bring the Laughter in Oscars ReunionThe stars of "Bridesmaids" were ready to party at the 2026 Oscars. Kristen Wiig, Maya Rudolph, Melissa McCarthy, Rose Byrne and Ellie Kemper reunited on stage to present best original score and best sound. The ladies walked out to an instrumental version of “Hold On" by Wilson Phillips, the song they dance to at the end of the film.During their time on stage, they did a bit where they read notes from the audience.Melissa McCarthy, Rose Byrne, Kristen Wiig, Maya Rudolph and Ellie Kemper from "Bridesmaids" reunited to present original score at the 2026 Oscars. PATRICK T. FALLON / AFP via Getty Images“Well mine says, ‘First of all, you ladies look extremely beautiful tonight... You’re all aging well, signed Stellan Skarsgård,’” Rudolph read. Byrne was next, reading, "Rose, can you please stop looking at me? The eye contact is too much. I’m thinking of leaving. I’m very uncomfortable. Sincerely, Leonardo DiCaprio."McCarthy also read a note that said, "I’m with Stellan Skarsgård writing my own separate note. I also agree you ladies look radiant. All the things you’ve done to your faces are very tasteful. Yours truly, Elle Fanning."She then said there was more, reading, "Just kidding, it’s me, again, Stellan Skarsgård."The notes continued before they wrapped up their bit and announced the nominees in the category.The moment comes as the comedy, directed by Paul Feig, celebrates its 15th anniversary. The film earned two Oscar nominations: best performance by an actress in a supporting role for McCarthy and best original screenplay for Wiig and co-writer Annie Mumolo.It's also a special night for Byrne, who is nominated for her first Academy Award for her role in “If I Had Legs I’d Kick You.”11d ago / 9:29 PM EDT'Mr. Nobody Against Putin' Wins Best Documentary Feature FilmJimmy Kimmel, who previously hosted the Academy Awards four times, was also on site tonight to present the award for best documentary feature film to the team behind "Mr. Nobody Against Putin."David Borenstein, Pavel Talankin, Helle Faber and Alžběta Karásková went on stage to accept the honor. Borenstein said their film "was about how you lose your country." He continued, "What we saw when working with this footage is that you lose it through countless, small little acts of complicity. When we act complicit. When a government murders people on the streets of our major cities. When we don't say anything. When oligarchs take over the media and control how we can produce it and consume it."As the crowd applauded, he concluded, "We all face a moral choice, but luckily even a nobody is more powerful than you think." The star of the film, Talankin, then spoke via a translator. He said, "In the name of our future, in the name of all of our children, stop all of these wars now." 11d ago / 9:21 PM EDT'All the Empty Rooms' Wins Best Documentary Short FilmMoving right along, Jimmy Kimmel took the stage to present the Oscar for the best documentary films. After a quick jab at Conan O'Brien's hosting gig, claiming he's taking over the role going forward, Kimmel celebrated the filmmakers who risk their lives to create documentaries.The winners of best documentary short film was Joshua Seftel and Conall Jones for "All the Empty Rooms," a film that shows the bedrooms of children killed in school shootings.To accept the award, the mother of Jackie Cazares, who was killed in the Uvalde school shooting in May 2022, said she hopes if people see this film, "we'd be a different America." 11d ago / 9:15 PM EDT'Avatar: Fire and Ash' Wins Visual Effects OscarJames Cameron's "Avatar: Fire and Ash" joins the list of movies that earned an Oscar at this year's ceremony. The third installment in the franchise won for best visual effects. Joe Letteri, Richard Baneham, Eric Saindon and Daniel Barrett accepted the honor. During his acceptance speech, Baneham revealed that 2,200 artists worked on film. "This is a massive, massive collaboration on the visual effects side," he said as he also thanked all their families. Saindon then recognized the late film producer Jon Landau, who died in July 2024 as Variety reported. "We miss you and you're still the heart and soul of this movie," Saindon said. 11d ago / 9:07 PM EDT'Frankenstein' Wins Production Design“Frankenstein” continued to win big during the 2026 Oscars, winning the award for production design. Tamara Deverell and Shane Vieau took the stage to thank director Guillermo del Toro, everyone they worked with, as well as "Frankenstein" novelist Mary Shelley.Others nominated in the category included “Hamnet,” “Marty Supreme," “One Battle After Another” and “Sinners.”11d ago / 9:01 PM EDTWhy Isn't Sean Penn at the Oscars? (He Was a Winner!)Sean Penn won the best supporting actor Oscar for his performance in "One Battle After Another" but the acting legend was nowhere to be found during the ceremony."Sean Penn couldn’t be here this evening, or didn’t want to, so I’ll be accepting the award of his behalf,” presenter Kieran Culkin quipped.Penn skipped several high-profile awards events this season after showing up to the Golden Globes and losing to “Sentimental Value" star Stellan Skarsgård. Penn appeared in the audience throughout the ceremony conspicuously smoking cigarettes.Penn then failed to show up to the Actor Awards and the BAFTAs in London. Turns out, he won in his category at both his events.And tonight, he's an Oscar winner for the third time.Penn previously won best actor Oscars for 2009’s “Milk” and 2004’s “Mystic River."Penn has been nominated five times in all and opted to skip three of the ceremonies.He previously told Variety in 2023 he would be willing to melt down his Oscar statues to make bullets for the Ukrainian war effort.11d ago / 9:00 PM EDTBarbra Streisand Sings 'The Way We Were' For Late Co-Star Robert RedfordTo remember the late great Robert Redford, who died in September 2025, Barbra Streisand took the Oscars stage to share her favorite memories with the actor, including the story behind his nickname for her, "Babs." She also took the mic to sing part of "The Way We Were," a song featured in their 1973 classic romance film of the same name. Barbra Streisand pays tribute to Robert Redford during the 98th Oscars at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. Kevin Winter / Getty Images11d ago / 8:58 PM EDTRachel McAdams Remembers Catherine O'Hara and Diane KeatonIn another set of tributes, Rachel McAdams took the stage to remember the lives of Catherine O'Hara and Diane Keaton. McAdams called O'Hara her "fellow Canadian" and remembered her as an actor who made everyone laugh until they cried.She then honored the legacy of Diane Keaton, whom McAdams worked with on "The Family Stone." She remembered Keaton's presence on set and her love for her family.Rachel McAdams speaks during the in memoriam segment during the 98th Annual Academy Awards at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, California on March 15, 2026. PATRICK T. FALLON / AFP via Getty Images11d ago / 8:55 PM EDTBilly Crystal and Meg Ryan Honor Rob Reiner in Emotional Tribute"When Harry Met Sally..." co-stars Billy Crystal and Meg Ryan took the stage during the Academy Awards to pay tribute to the late Rob Reiner. Crystal opened the in memoriam section of the show with a moving tribute to Reiner's work in Hollywood and his life of activism. Rob Reiner, who directed the 1989 rom-com, and wife Michele Singer Reiner were found dead in their Los Angeles home on Dec. 14 from apparent stab wounds, a source told NBC News at the time. Rob Reiner, who had a lengthy acting career starred in “All in the Family,” “The First Wives Club,” “New Girl,” and “The Bear.” He also directed “This Is Spinal Tap,” “A Few Good Men” “Stand By Me” and “The Princess Bride,” among others. After his moving words, Crystal was joined by Ryan and other stars of Reiner's films, including Demi Moore, Kathy Bates, Mandy Patinkin and more.(L-R) Michael McKean, Christopher Guest, Jerry O'Connell, Wil Wheaton, Fred Savage, Cary Elwes, Mandy Patinkin, Carol Kane, Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Kiefer Sutherland, Demi Moore, Kevin Pollak, Kathy Bates, Annette Bening, John Cusack and Daphne Zuniga honor the late Rob Reiner on stage during the 98th Oscars at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. Kevin Winter / Getty Images11d ago / 8:41 PM EDTPaul Thomas Anderson wins 1st Oscar for Adapted ScreenplayAfter 14 nominations, acclaimed director Paul Thomas Anderson can finally add an Oscar to his resume. He kissed longtime partner Maya Rudolph before heading to the stage to collect his first golden statue. After the audience gave him a standing ovation, Anderson said he was "incredibly honored to be a part of this history."He thanked author Thomas Pynchon, who wrote the book "Vineland," which the film is inspired by."Any writer knows that you either beg for forgiveness or your special thanks is really to your family and the people that you share a roof with, who put up with what it means to live with a writer," he continued before naming Rudolph and their children. Anderson added, "I wrote this movie for my kids to say sorry for the housekeeping mess that we left in this world we're handing off to them. But also with the encouragement that they will be the generation that hopefully brings up some common sense and decency." 11d ago / 8:40 PM EDT'Sinners' Wins Best Original Screenplay, Marking Ryan Coogler's First OscarRyan Coogler accepts the award for original screenplay for "Sinners" during the 2026 Oscars on March 15. PATRICK T. FALLON / AFP via Getty ImagesRyan Coogler won the Academy Award for best original screenplay for the blockbuster hit "Sinners." To thunderous applause, Coogler thanked the Academy and his fellow nominees, as well as his family and his parents, who were in the crowd.Coogler is up for two more awards tonight, and he has five nominations overall.This is the first win of the night for "Sinners," which entered the ceremony with 16 nominations — the most ever in the history of the Oscars.11d ago / 8:33 PM EDTRobert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans Reunite 14 Years After 1st 'Avengers'It's a mini "Avengers" reunion!Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans reunited on the Oscars stage for a bit about their "anniversary." Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans reunited during the Oscars on March 15, 2026. Kevin Winter / Getty Images"It's the 14th-year anniversary of our first 'Avengers' movie. I got you a signed copy of the original script, signed by the whole cast. It's backstage. See I really thought this through," Evans said. In return, Downey playfully gave Evans his valet ticket before the two presented the award for best adapted screenplay. When the two returned to present best original screenplay, Downehy had an upgraded gift: Channing Tatum's "Magic Mike" thong. Tatum then chimed in from the audience and said he needed the underwear back because he had to work later. 11d ago / 8:26 PM EDTSean Penn Wins Best Supporting Actor Despite Missing Oscar Awards CeremonySean Penn won an Oscar for best supporting actor for his role in "One Battle After Another," though the star wasn't in attendance.Kieran Culkin, who presented the award, accepted it on Penn's behalf in his absence. "Sean Penn couldn't be here this evening, or didn't want to, so I'll be accepting the award of his behalf," Culkin, who won best supporting actor in 2025, said.Penn beat out co-star Benicio Del Toro, Jacob Elordi, Delroy Lindo and Stellan Skarsgard.11d ago / 8:25 PM EDTTwo Movies Share Win for Live Action Short Film It was a tie in the live action short film category.The award went to two films: “The Singers” and “Two People Exchanging Saliva.”“The Singers” is a short musical comedy directed by Sam A. Davis that features a cast sourced in part through viral videos.The French-language “Two People Exchanging Saliva,” written and directed by Natalie Musteata and Alexandre Singh, “is a “weird” and “queer” film about the power of connection in a dystopian world that forbids kissing, Musteata said during her acceptance speech.Other live action short films nominated in the same category included “Butcher’s Stain,” “A Friend of Dorothy” and “Jane Austen’s Period Drama.”11d ago / 8:14 PM EDTConan O'Brien Leaves Note and Snacks for AttendeesConan O'Brien may be hosting the Oscars, but he also left a note and "moderately happy meal" for nominees, plus ones and seat fillers inside the Dolby Theatre. Shared by Deadline, the message begins with the comedian welcoming the guests to the awards show. "These snacks may not look like much but in any movie theater they would run you $85," it read, reminding people to have fun and that laughter is "good for your health and ego."It concluded with a drawing of O'Brien.11d ago / 8:12 PM EDTCassandra Kulukundis Wins First-Ever Oscar for Casting"One Battle After Another" casting director Cassandra Kulukundis made history at the 2026 Oscars as the first-ever recipient of an Academy Award for achievement in casting. For the inaugural award, stars from each of the nominated films were tapped to deliver sweet remarks to their respective casting directors: "Hamnet" star Paul Mescal, "Marty Supreme" star Gwyneth Paltrow, "One Battle After Another" star Chase Infiniti, "The Secret Agent" star Wagner Moura and "Sinners" star Delroy Lindo.The new category was the first addition to the ceremony in 24 years, the broadcast said.While accepting the distinct honor, Kulukundis thanked the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences and her fellow casting directors for the category being recognized "despite everything in their way."She added, "I dedicate this to you" and to the casting directors who didn't get their credit in the past. Speaking directly to director Paul Thomas Anderson, she said, "I just thank you, I mean, for 10 movies. We've done this for over 30 years. We grew up together, I guess, and this is freaking insane. And I had one before you which is also crazy. I hope you get one tonight." 11d ago / 8:02 PM EDT'Frankenstein' Wins for Makeup and Hairstyling The hair and makeup team behind Guillermo del Toro’s “Frankenstein” won the Oscar in the makeup and hairstyling category.Led by Mike Hill, Jordan Samuel and Cliona Furey, the team created a fresh look for the monster protagonist of Mary Shelley's classic work of gothic literature, played in the film by Jacob Elordi.Other films nominated in the same category included “Kokuho,” “Sinners,” “The Smashing Machine” and “The Ugly Stepsister”11d ago / 7:54 PM EDT'Frankenstein' Wins Best Costume DesignAfter an iconic presentation by Anne Hathaway and Anna Wintour, the Oscar for best costume design went to "Frankenstein," which beat out “Avatar: Fire and Ash," “Hamnet," “Marty Supreme” and “Sinners." Guillermo Del Toro's "Frankenstein" is a moody, Gothic film adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic novel. For the film, Jacob Elordi became unrecognizable as the titular character's monster.11d ago / 7:52 PM EDTAnna Wintour Takes a 'Devil Wears Prada' Dig at Anne Hathaway While Presenting: 'Thank You, Emily'Anna Wintour and Anne Hathaway present during the 98th Annual Academy Awards at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood on March 15, 2026. PATRICK T. FALLON / AFP via Getty ImagesAhead of the release of "Devil Wears Prada 2" in April, Anne Hathaway stepped out on the Oscars stage alongside the film franchise's long rumored inspiration, Anna Wintour.For the sketch, Hathaway asked Wintour for her thoughts on her Oscars outfit. Donning her signature black sunglasses and giving nothing away, Wintour simply responded, "And the nominees are..." The two also presented the best makeup and hairstyling category, with Hathaway leading the way. As she ended, Wintour simply quipped, "Thank you, Emily," before announcing the nominees. 11d ago / 7:52 PM EDTTimothée Chalamet and Kylie Jenner Have a Date Night at the OscarsTimothée Chalamet and Kylie Jenner made their way inside the Dolby Theatre looking like superstars. The beauty entrepreneur wore a red sequin gown to support her boyfriend, the "Marty Supreme" star who is nominated for best actor. The two were hand-in-hand as they made their way to their seats.11d ago / 7:46 PM EDTMiles Caton and Raphael Saadiq Bring 'Sinners' to the Stage“Sinners” was celebrated at the 2026 Oscars when Miles Caton and Raphael Saadiq performed the Academy Award-nominated original song “I Lied To You” from the film.Miles Caton and Jayme Lawson perform onstage during the 98th Oscars at Dolby Theatre on March 15, 2026 in Hollywood.
